text:
Elena: quick oncall note 79: operators couldn't trace fallbacks to audit rows from the rollout UI. It just shows 'degraded' with no link.
Sam: seen it. backend decision payload has event_id but we removed it from UI for safety. we need a safe compromise.
Priya: reminder: we sketched a tiny 'Why' flyout in figma that surfaces rule + trigger + a sanitized sample. still not shipped.
Elena: backend sends `{"decision":"fallback","reason":"high_latency","event_id":"evt_2790011223"}` today. security didn't want raw ids in the client.
Mike: suggestion: mint a short-lived trace token that maps to the audit row, ACL-checked on access. UI shows token link, not raw id.
Sam: infra can emit `trace_token`, `sample_rate`, and `trigger_counts`. example: `{"trace_token":"tkn_p9x","sample_rate":0.2,"trigger_counts":{"high_latency":4}}`. the token contains no user content.
Priya: UI proposal: rollout header shows `Fallbacks: 4 sampled / 18 total` with a tooltip about sampling. clicking the count opens the flyout listing rule, trigger, sample flag, and one sanitized example (first 32 chars + ...).
Elena: also rename confusing degrade labels. ops asked what 'soft-cut' meant. proposing canonical names: Graceful, Failover, Silent with one-line descriptions.
Mike: product ok with those names. add small icons and microcopy.
Sam: implementation note: we'll store a hash->event_id mapping in the audit db, mint HMAC-based trace_token TTL=24h. token endpoint will validate ACL then redirect to the audit UI.
Priya: examples must be sanitized server-side. no full user text, redact emails/keys. provide `sanitized_example` field in the API.
OpsBot: audit service mapped evt_2790011223 -> https://audit.redwood/evt_2790011223 (access requires SSO + role). :lock:
Elena: action list: Sam -> add trace_token, counts endpoint, and histogram; Priya -> mocks + flyout + label copy; Mike -> label signoff and gating for replay.
Sam: ETA: trace_token + counts by Thu EOD, histogram next week.
Priya: I'll have mocks Wed and a feature-flagged branch Thu for a small operator beta.
Mike: confirm replay on audit rows will be internal-only and gated.
Elena: thanks team. Thu 10am sync to handoff.
Sam: :thumbsup:
Priya: :+1:
